positions.title: Senior Claims Coordinator
positions.description:
Provides global supply chain consulting and services to our partners and their suppliers.
Responsible for managing, inspecting, and validating cargo claims against Ryder.
Created and maintained tracking reports and forecasts for the customer and Ryder.
Dispatched drivers using Ryde-Smart tracking for On-Time recording and Customer reporting.
Fully trained in payroll in the RD2000 system.
Processed payroll for 100 plus employees including drivers being paid miles, stops, and gap pay.

positions.title: Chemical Operator
positions.description:
Lithium Corporation of America is a mining company which mined lithium-bearing spodumene and pegmatite
ores. 
Managed recording of instruments, flow meters, panel lights, and warning signals to verify the conformity of process conditions.
Recorded data, constructed chemical circuits, implemented test results, and readings.

positions.title: Aviation Specialist
positions.description:
The United States Navy is the naval warfare service branch of the United States Armed Forces and one of the seven uniformed services of the United States.
Aviation Logistics Team Lead.
Inventoried and inspected equipment needed in the day-to-day task of aviation mechanics and maintenance crew.
Set parameters and projections to improve inventory control.
Delivered daily reports on a daily basis to ensure completeness of materials handled.
